Bioinformatics Resource Center - Rockefeller University" author: - "[http://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/responsible_use_of_Agentic_AI/](http://rockefelleruniversity.github.io/responsible_use_of_Agentic_AI/)" - "[brc@rockefeller.edu](mailto:brc@rockefeller.edu)" --- ::: {.content-hidden when-format="revealjs"} # Responsible Use of Agentic AI: Adversarial Review ::: ## Overview - [Why review AI output adversarially?](#why-review-ai-output-adversarially) - [Running an adversarial review](#running-an-adversarial-review) - [Limits of AI reviewing AI](#limits-of-ai-reviewing-ai) - [Exercises](#time-for-an-exercise) # Adversarial Review {background-color="#23373B" .center .middle} ## Why review AI output adversarially? ??Asking a model (ideally a fresh session or a different model) to find faults in work rather than confirm it; sycophancy and confirmation bias?? ## Running an adversarial review ??Prompts and workflows for red-teaming an analysis, document or piece of code; verifying each reported issue before acting on it?? ## Limits of AI reviewing AI ??Shared blind spots, false positives, and why the human remains the final check?? ## Time for an exercise Exercises are available [here](../exercises/exercises/Exercise_Adversarial_Review_exercise.html).
